authority: Bounded source-delta review and existing focused tests
observedChange: Failed direct Turbo steps now declare their input digest to the parent ledger.
Failed wrapper and direct lanes resolve input digest and package scope through the same source path as passed lanes.
The digest folds selected taskId/hash pairs regardless of task outcome; an empty selection still returns None.
Exact failed proof facts are rejected with prior-failed. Retaining a failed observation is not accepting it for reuse.
semanticInputs: Task selection and complete selected taskId/hash rows
Summary start times, caller start time and file modification times
Wrapper ledger path, declarations and completion state
Declared digest, if supplied, which takes precedence with no derived package scope
Existing proof facts, outcome, profile, epoch and expiry context
effects: Reads and decodes fresh Turbo run summaries
Removes temporary wrapper ledger directory after resolution
Records failed observations for comparison with prior evidence; does not change hosted proof ownership
limits: Selected-row equality is required for equal keys: an aborted run with a different task set can produce a different digest.
These tests exercise fixtures and focused ledger behavior, not exhaustive real-lane executions or signed remote qualification.
Complete transitive error, persistence, orchestration and concurrency semantics remain outside this receipt.
